messages:
maria: Quick intake — product wants us to onboard a new open 30B (kestrel-30b-open) for hosted + dedicated. Primary ask: performance baseline and a quantization plan. Key targets: stable at 512 ctx, p95 <= 130ms @ batch=1 for short replies, and throughput profile for batching.

devin: Can you add expected SLOs and hardware? helps prioritize. Also any redlines for quality regressions?

maria: SLOs: p95 <= 130ms @ batch=1 (A100-80GB), throughput target: >= 2x tokens/s vs orion13b baseline on same infra. Hardware: A100-80 and a T4 cluster for cheap quantized comparisons. Quality: automatic gating if eval BLEU/accuracy drops > 2% relative to reference checks.

sam: I can run perf sweep tomorrow. Need model artifact + tokenizer + opt weights. Also confirm max sequence lengths to test — we should do 128/512/2048.

maria: artifact: s3://redwood-models/kestrel-30b-open/v1/model.tar.gz

sam: Ack. Plan for perf runs:
- cold load time
- batch sweep: [1,2,4,8,16]
- ctx sweep: [128,512,2048]
- measure p50/p90/p95/p99 and tokens/sec

akshay: I'll own quant experiments. Proposal:
- try GPTQ int4, AWQ int4, and int8 fallback
- log LL/perplexity + discrete eval metrics on 100-shot evalset
- flag any metric delta > 2% (absolute) for manual review

tessa: Suggest adding a quick regressions harness: 100 prompt set (mix of instruction, summarization, code). Run both full precision and quant variants and save diffs. Also add a small hallucination check for QA prompts.

perf-bot: Created perf job tracker #PRF-4231 and added owners: sam, akshay, tessa

sam: Command I'll use (local wrapper):
```
./run_perf \
  --model s3://redwood-models/kestrel-30b-open/v1/model.tar.gz \
  --hardware a100-80 \
  --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8,16 \
  --ctx 128,512,2048 \
  --quant none,gptq-int4,awq-int4,int8 \
  --out s3://redwood-perf/kestrel-30b-open/v1/
```

devin: Please capture memory peaks and GPU util for each run. Also include KV cache mem vs ctx.

akshay: One gotcha: AWQ needs a transformer layer reordering patch we already used for zephyr-13b. I'll port it to kestrel, but it may add ~5% perf overhead. Marking as experimental.

tessa: Prioritization: if perf shows p95>200ms at batch=1 for fp32, move to dedicated trial before hosted. If quantized fp16/int4 meets cost goals with <2% quality drop, prefer T4 inference pool for cheaper ops.

maria: Ownership recap: sam -> perf sweeps & logging, akshay -> quant builds, tessa -> eval/regressions harness, devin -> SLA/pass/fail criteria + rollout decision. I'll schedule a sync Thu 10am to review initial numbers. :calendar:

sam: Starting runs now, will ping with first baseline artifacts. :rocket:

akshay: Kicking off GPTQ conversion, expect first quant checkpoints in ~6h. :hourglass:

maria: Thanks team. If we hit a sudden quality regression, tag me and do NOT auto-rollout any quant variant to hosted. :no_entry:

sam: noted. I'll attach perf logs and sampling traces to PRF-4231 when done.

devin: thx. Small ask — include a short README in s3 perf folder with run commands and env. makes audits easier.

maria: good point. add that to checklist. :thumbsup:
